examples.title: Motion follow
examples.desc: A disc on the motion centroid, sized by the amount of motion (needs a moving picture on Send 1). Uses Send 1's frame buffer in its linear layout: if a warp or rotation has been used since boot, starting switches it back (the output flashes white once); refused while a warp or rotation is on.

examples.title: Motion heat cells
examples.desc: Cells swap channels where the picture moves (needs a moving picture on Send 1). Uses Send 1's frame buffer in its linear layout: if a warp or rotation has been used since boot, starting switches it back (the output flashes white once); refused while a warp or rotation is on.

examples.title: Linear gradient
examples.desc: 12 levels along each line from 4 per-pixel bits (16-level palette); the angle rocks. k0 extra angle, k1 spacing.

examples.title: Radial gradient
examples.desc: 5 rings on a moving centre, chord ends evaluated every line.

examples.title: Wave curtain
examples.desc: 12 levels, each boundary a travelling sine.

examples.title: Lit sphere
examples.desc: Smooth shading along each line: per line the area spans the disc's chord and its ramp starts at the light's value; the light turns. k0 extra light angle, k1 radius, k2 light speed. Crossfades Send 1 into its PIP layer 2, which is Send 2's picture: give Send 2 a different picture from Send 1 (another input, or one with nothing connected for black), or nothing visible changes.

examples.title: Soft wavy wipe
examples.desc: Full-width ramps whose start follows a moving sine. k0 steepness, k1 wave amplitude. Crossfades Send 1 into its PIP layer 2, which is Send 2's picture: give Send 2 a different picture from Send 1 (another input, or one with nothing connected for black), or nothing visible changes.

examples.title: Soft stripes
examples.desc: Steeper ramps wrap into soft stripes (steps where the start wraps between bands). Crossfades Send 1 into its PIP layer 2, which is Send 2's picture: give Send 2 a different picture from Send 1 (another input, or one with nothing connected for black), or nothing visible changes.

examples.title: Colour wheel (canvas)
examples.desc: A turning colour wheel evaluated on a 640x360 16-bit YCbCr OSD canvas, interpolated, double-buffered at the frame rate.

examples.title: Plasma (canvas)
examples.desc: A four-term colour plasma on a 640x360 OSD canvas. k0 speed, k1 scale.

examples.title: Tunnel (canvas)
examples.desc: A tunnel on a 640x288 OSD canvas (the size that holds 24 fps).

examples.title: Palette field (8-bit canvas)
examples.desc: The shader's value becomes an 8-bit palette index on a 960x432 canvas; the palette rotates every frame. k6 palette speed, k7 spread.

examples.title: Palette cycling
examples.desc: A full-screen colour field drawn once into an 8-bit canvas, then animated only by rewriting the 256-entry palette every frame. k0 speed, k1 spread, k2 transparency over the video.

examples.title: Colour wheel (frame buffer)
examples.desc: The pixel runner drawing a 320x160 panel straight into Send 1's frame buffer, raced against the input. k4/k5 move the panel. Uses Send 1's frame buffer in its linear layout: if a warp or rotation has been used since boot, starting switches it back (the output flashes white once); refused while a warp or rotation is on.

examples.title: Plasma (frame buffer, C)
examples.desc: A colour plasma panel written in C, drawn into Send 1's frame buffer. k0 speed, k1 scale, k2 chroma. Uses Send 1's frame buffer in its linear layout: if a warp or rotation has been used since boot, starting switches it back (the output flashes white once); refused while a warp or rotation is on.

examples.title: Ripple warp
examples.desc: Concentric waves from the centre through the warp LUT. k0 amplitude (px), k1 speed.

examples.title: Glitch blocks
examples.desc: Block cells jump on a beat with a liquid wobble underneath. k0 jump amplitude (px), k1 beats per second.
